head: iPhone Duo laptop mode: Screens 5 shows your Mac on the top half
dek: Edovia's remote desktop app Screens 5 has a laptop mode for the iPhone Duo in version 5.10.6, out on iPhone since 25 November: fold the phone halfway and your Mac appears on the upper half, with a keyboard and trackpad on the lower half.
details: The trackpad takes the same gestures as the regular Screens app, and the keyboard follows your system language; swiping down on a key gives its second character, as on an iPad. The app is free to download but needs a subscription, which Macworld puts at $4.99 a month; Edovia offers a 7-day free trial. Edovia told Macworld the matching Mac update was waiting for App Store approval.
where: iPhone Duo with Screens 5 version 5.10.6 and a Screens subscription, out now
means: If you have an iPhone Duo and need your Mac while away from it, the phone can now work like a tiny laptop for it, as long as you pay for Screens.
todo: Update Screens 5, fold the Duo halfway, connect to your Mac and turn on laptop mode; if you start the trial, cancel before it ends if you don't want to pay.
